refnamediv.refpurpose: display the spawn invulnerability shield countdown on the HUD

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: cg_drawSpawnShieldTimer controls the display of the spawn invulnerability shield countdown timer on the right side of the HUD. When enabled, a pulsing icon and remaining time are shown while the player has spawn protection active. A value of 0 hides the indicator.
